_doc: #3215 Q-C8 A: how the real Figma host defines its methods, per surface, as component-shim.ts models it. `methods` is `fixed` (own data properties, neither writable nor configurable) or `plain`. `provenance` says where the entry came from: `measured` on a real host, `assumed` (a stricter guess a test already relies on), or `unmeasured`. The canary's descriptor read (tools/figma-canary, the run-code step) is the measurement that replaces an `assumed` or `unmeasured` entry; it comes from the real host, never from the shim (docs/34). Change an entry only with that measurement, quoted in `source`.
